title: Humanity Remains
summary: A free-to-play 2D sandbox MMORPG inspired by classic old-school MMOs. Train skills, battle powerful bosses, master combat styles, trade in a player-driven economy, and grind your way to greatness on PC and mobile.
about:
Welcome to Lost Lands, a free-to-play 2D sandbox MMORPG inspired by the golden era of online RPGs. Whether you want to become a legendary warrior, a master skiller, a wealthy trader, or a relentless boss hunter, your journey is entirely your own.

Explore a persistent online world built around progression, freedom, and long-term goals. With 17 unique skills to train, rare loot to obtain, powerful gear upgrades to unlock, and a fully player-driven economy, every action pushes your character forward.

Lost Lands is designed for players who enjoy the grind. Progress is rewarding, relaxing, and satisfying without demanding impossible difficulty. Every level earned, boss defeated, and item crafted contributes to your legacy.

Key Features

• 
17 Skills to Master
Train and level a wide variety of skills from 1-100, with hundreds of hours of progression available.
• 
Classic Point-and-Click Combat
Simple and satisfying combat featuring 3 combat styles with unique gear and progression paths.
• 
Sandbox Freedom
Quest, skill, boss, farm, loot, trade, or simply explore the world at your own pace.
• 
Player-Driven Economy
Buy, sell, and trade with other players in a living economy shaped entirely by the community.
• 
Bosses & Rare Rewards
Take on dangerous bosses for unique drops used to upgrade combat and skilling equipment.
• 
Play Anywhere
Available on both Steam and mobile with cross-platform progression.
• 
Free-to-Play Friendly
Premium membership can be purchased with in-game currency earned through gameplay.
• 
Long-Term Progression
Average around 50 hours per skill to reach level 100, offering meaningful goals for dedicated players.

Whether you're chasing max skills, building wealth, hunting rare drops, or becoming a master of every profession, the Lost Lands are yours to conquer.
